answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 156320 Country: India Title: A non-Muslim boy has proposed my sister Question: A non-Muslim boy has proposed my sister. We explained her that it is haram and restricted her from talking to him, even though she secretly makes a call to him. Can you please guide me in the light of Quran and Hadith, so that I don't want her to lose her Immanuel. Answer ID: 156320 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 209/159/N=2/1439) You should convince your sister and also try to change her thoughts through some pious and God-fearing lady. Also supplicate Allah for the same. I, too, pray wholeheartedly, may Allah guide her and distance her from that non-Muslim boy. If possible, you or your mother should read the following wazifah with durood 11-11 times before and after daily 300 times. In-shaAllah, your sister shall distance herself from that non-Muslim boy soon. يَا مُقَلِّبَ القُلُوبِ والأبْصَارِ ، يَا خَالِقَ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهَارِ ، يَا عَزِيْزُ ، يَا لَطِيْفُ ، يَا غَفَّارُ . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
